title: Vishnu Dharmam - 05 - Tapas
author: Vishnu Sreenivas
excerpt:
In our previous entry, we saw the concept of Dhaanam. Now we shall see the idea of Tapas.

According to Shounaka Maharishi, anyone can become a tapsvi during their lifetime. When we hear the word tapasvi, we should not imagine the great rishis or munis. Being a tapasvi is a process and a way of life. As said earlier, anyone can perform Tapasand become a tapasvi if they follow some simple discipline.
